message.message: rTorrent will not pause torrents when they meet the seed criteria. Lidarr will handle automatic removal of torrents based on the current seed criteria in Settings->Indexers only when Remove Completed is enabled.  After importing it will also set "lidarr_imported" as an rTorrent view, which can be used in rTorrent scripts to customize behavior.
